Our work overview

Building brighter futures through connected opportunity.

AMEF brings education, skills, health and protection closer to families and communities so children and young people can thrive with dignity and opportunity.

Our work

Creating Pathways to Lasting Opportunity

At AMEF, we believe lasting change happens when people have the opportunity to learn, earn, live healthier lives and grow in safe, supportive environments. Through Education, Livelihood, Health Care and Child Protection, we connect knowledge, skills, wellbeing and protection to help children, young people, women and families build stronger futures.

Explore our programme areas and discover how each contributes to stronger, more resilient communities.

Programme showcase

Four pathways, one shared mission.

01 · Education

Education

AMEF is expanding access to secondary education and building learning opportunities that combine academic learning with practical skills, leadership and confidence.

02 · Livelihood

Livelihood

03 · Health Care

Health Care

04 · Child Protection

Child Protection

Explore Child Protection

An integrated approach

Opportunity is bigger than a classroom.

AMEF works across education, health, livelihoods and child protection because each area strengthens the others. A child who is protected, healthy, learning and supported by practical skills is better positioned to thrive and contribute to their community.
